summary: Intuit Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a restructuring plan to simplify its organizational structure, reducing its workforce by ~17% and considering site closures. The company expects $300-$340 million in charges, primarily for severance and benefits, mostly in Q4 fiscal 2026 ending July 31, 2026, with actions substantially completed by Q1 fiscal 2027 ending October 31, 2026. The board approved a cash dividend. This is a cost-cutting restructuring, not a sale or acquisition. Watch for execution risk and further charges.
